title: When Do Repetition Loops Lock? Truncation Sampling, Bounded Penalties, and a Blind Spot in DRY
abstract: arXiv:2610.24715v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models sometimes repeat verbatim until the generation limit. We study the exit rather than the entrance: given that a span has already been repeated $n$ times, when is escape still possible? Along the loop the context is deterministic, so the probability that a loop survives $m$ more repetitions is, under any sampler, a product of per-step continuation probabilities computable from one forward pass. A lock, where this probability stays exactly one, is its limiting case. Pure sampling never locks; top-$p$ with threshold $\pi>1/2$ locks a position exactly when the continuation probability reaches $\pi$. A bounded penalty can leave a position locked; a penalty that outgrows the model's preference for the loop over unseen tokens guarantees escape under top-$p$. The same analysis shows a blind spot in the widely deployed DRY sampler: its sequence breakers cap the penalty at $\lambda b^{g-1-a}$ for loops whose longest breaker-free

translated_title: 重复循环何时锁定？截断采样、有界惩罚与DRY采样器的盲点
translated_abstract: 语言模型有时会逐字重复直到达到生成上限。我们研究的是循环的“出口”而非“入口”：当一个片段已经被重复了 n 次之后，何时仍有可能逃脱？在循环内部，上下文是确定性的，因此在任何采样器下，循环再延续 m 次重复的存活概率等于每一步延续概率的乘积，并且可以通过一次前向传播计算得到。锁定（即该概率恰好恒为 1）是这种情形的极限。纯采样永远不会锁定；对于阈值 π>1/2 的 top-p 采样，当延续概率达到 π 时，某个位置恰好被锁定。有界惩罚可能使某个位置保持锁定状态；而一个增长速度超过模型对循环（相对于未见过的词元）偏好的惩罚，则能在 top-p 下保证逃脱。同样的分析揭示了被广泛部署的DRY采样器中的一个盲点：其序列断路器将惩罚上限设为 λb^(g-1-a)，对于最长无断路器片段的循环……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了语言模型重复循环逃逸概率的理论分析框架，证明纯采样永不锁定、top-p采样恰在延续概率达到阈值时锁定，并据此揭示了广泛使用的DRY采样器因惩罚上限而无法保证逃脱循环的盲点。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a theoretical framework for when repetition loops in language models become inescapable—showing that pure sampling never locks while top-p locks exactly when the continuation probability reaches its threshold—and uses it to expose a blind spot in the widely deployed DRY sampler, whose capped penalties cannot guarantee escape.
